env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2

cd m

# A basename alone is not a platform suffix. The unaliased versioned
# import declares rand, not v2, and must survive in the receiver file.
logos eject -o out
exists out/linux.go
grep '"math/rand/v2"' out/linux.go
exists out/linux_jsonv2.go
! exists out/_jsonv2_linux.go
cp stream_check.txt out/stream_check_test.go

cd out
go run .
stdout '^roll 0$'
go test .
go vet .
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/importname

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("roll", Roll()) }

-- m/linux.lgo --
package main

import "math/rand/v2"

type Data struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
}

func Roll() int { return rand.IntN(1) }

-- m/stream_check.txt --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestStreamingMethod(t *testing.T) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := (Data{Title: "hello"}).MarshalJSONTo(jsontext.NewEncoder(&buf)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := strings.TrimSpace(buf.String()); got != `{"title":"hello"}` {
		t.Fatalf("stream = %q", got)
	}
}
